headline: Executive order requires federal employees to get the COVID-19 vaccine.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Biden, requires people who work for the federal government to be vaccinated against COVID-19. The title is the only official information provided here, so details such as exceptions, deadlines, and how agencies would enforce the rule are not described.

who_it_affects.how: They are required to get vaccinated against COVID-19 as a condition of their federal job.
They are responsible for carrying out the vaccination requirement for their workers.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 9, 2021; specific compliance deadlines are not stated in the title.
